mandatory_conditions.condition: 다섯 장 모두 사진적 표현과 성인 한 명의 한 손 사용 장면을 유지한다. 팔·상반신과 손의 연결을 보여 준다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Exactly one adult torso and one visible active hand. Hand continues into wrist and short forearm at right crop; no detached hand or second hand behind paper.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 원통형 코르크 받침 위의 스테인리스 스프링 집게, 앞쪽 실리콘 패드 두 턱, 뒤 레버라는 공통 구조를 유지한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Cylindrical cork base supports connected stainless spring clamp, clear rear lever/hinge and near silicone pad. Far jaw contact pad is concealed behind the paper and not separately legible.
mandatory_conditions.residual: Two silicone pads are not both clearly identifiable.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 뒤 레버를 누르면 앞 턱이 열리고 놓으면 종이를 잡는 기능이 각 이미지 자체에서 식별되어야 한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Single index finger presses the rear lever while thumb stabilizes beneath; memo is already at front jaw mouth. Dark mouth/gap visible around lower paper edge, but opening-versus-closed jaw relationship is less explicit because far pad is occluded.
mandatory_conditions.residual: Rear lever use is clear; full open/close mechanism remains only partly demonstrated.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 필수 제품의 받침·집게·실리콘 턱을 장식·극단적 크롭·과도한 피사계 심도로 숨기지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Base, steel spring clamp, rear lever and near pad remain large and sharp. Far pad is hidden by memo rather than extreme crop or blur.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 코르크·금속·실리콘·종이·피부는 각각의 표면과 빛 반응을 갖는다. 모든 면에 같은 미세 무늬나 광택을 입히지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Cork has coarse porous warm granules; metal smooth bright/dark directional reflections; near silicone softly matte; paper smooth with restrained fibers; skin natural detail; desk subtle and background softer.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 각 문자열은 한 번씩 보존한다. 종이에 제공된 카피를 배치할 수 있으나 별도 메모 내용·로고·가짜 문자는 추가하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: All six exact strings printed once; memo completely blank; no extra logos or lettering.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 가상 제품이며 제공되지 않은 치수·성능·실제 모델의 정확한 재현을 주장하지 않는다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: No fabricated measurements, performance claims or exact-real-model reproduction claims.

mandatory_conditions.condition: 전체 다섯 장 안에서 2:3 두 장·1:1 두 장·3:2 한 장으로 배분한다.
mandatory_conditions.observed: Native 1536×1024 gives exact assigned 3:2; this maker did not inspect other slots.

self_observations.observation: Intact Korean strokes, spaces and punctuation; six strings readable at 720. Title compact/large, English subordinate, benefits and materials grouped.
Removing extra limb restores clear tabletop corridor. Title and one-hand lever arrival are balanced; paper is at endpoint rather than shown being carried.
Texture is more patchy/dense after correction than parent, while still different from smooth steel, silicone, paper and skin. No pixel preservation claimed.
Far silicone pad remains inadequately exposed. No extra decorative text, logo, arrows or obvious disconnected metal pieces; cannot infer complete physical function.

uncertainties: Far silicone pad cannot be confidently verified as separate visible surface.
Functional open/close relationship is partial rather than fully explicit.
The broad desk reach now records lever operation at paper arrival, not simultaneous paper transport.
Photographic depiction cannot establish actual mechanical performance.
correction_decision: Correction cap reached after initial + two repairs; choose repair-2 because it resolves two-hand mandatory defect while preserving accurate copy and material distinctions. Disclose remaining jaw visibility/function limitations.
